claims_and_limits.reddit_claim: RTX 4070 12 GB, 262K context and 70 tok/s; author says agentic workflow patch improves quality.
claims_and_limits.model_status: The Mirai Labs model card labels it experimental and measurements provisional.
claims_and_limits.model: Qwen3.8-27B-S trellis codec, about 2.4 bits per weight; GGUF conversion preserves codec data and uses ggml types 90-93.
claims_and_limits.runtime_compatibility: Stock llama.cpp cannot load the converted GGUF; a specialized Mirai fork/engine is required.
claims_and_limits.context: 262144 q8_0 KV positions are tiered: approximately 58K in VRAM, remainder in pinned RAM on the 4070 setup.
claims_and_limits.agent_layer: Optional API cards, API checking and run_python in WASI (128 MB/10s, no host files/network/processes). When client tools are present, the proxy omits run_python and sends API cards only.
claims_and_limits.quality_suite: Project-reported 37-task exact-work suite: ML2 raw 16/37 vs layer 29/37; ML2b raw 18/37 vs layer 28/37 (12 rescues, 2 losses); coding family across two seed sets raw 7/24 vs layer 12/24. HumanEval 164: 158 raw, 160 with example check, 154 with thinking off.
claims_and_limits.runtime_budget: The project's paired 37-task run (74 raw/layer executions) is reported as 3.5 hours; not eligible under the user's <=30-minute-per-profile, three-seed limit.
claims_and_limits.comparability: These are project-author results with project-specific profiles, suite and checks; they are not LlamaCode results or an independent comparison against SOL, ASTRA or Flash-Next Q4.

decision: No local model/runtime evaluation or download. Do not promote. The model/runtime is a separate custom profile requiring custom GGUF types; the patch's sandbox tool does not apply when LlamaCode sends client tools. Consider a separately named, pre-registered API-card screen only if it can fit <=30 minutes for three seeds.
